semiconductor_relevance: High — Asia IC Mic-Process, Inc. specializes in liquid blending and supply solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Asia IC Mic-Process, Inc. is a leading provider of liquid blending and delivery systems tailored for the semiconductor industry, focusing on Chemical Mechanical Polishing (CMP) and supply system development. With nearly 30 years of expertise, they offer comprehensive solutions including Slurry Delivery Systems and Chemical Delivery Systems, ensuring high-quality process management for advanced manufacturing.

regional_presence.Taiwan: AsiaICMP has service hubs in Linkou, Taichung, and Tainan, supporting local operations.
regional_presence.Singapore: The company has established a subsidiary to enhance regional support.
regional_presence.China: Subsidiaries in Shanghai, Suzhou, and Xiamen facilitate local service and sales.
